**Chinese name:** 福州瑞芯微电子股份有限公司 (Fúzhōu Ruìxīnwēi Diànzǐ Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2001 in Fuzhou, Fujian — one of China's longest-running fabless SoC vendors, widely used in white-label and embedded hardware globally (notably in the single-board-computer and IoT hobbyist hardware market). H1 2026 revenue reached ¥2.877 billion (+40.6% YoY) with net profit of ¥859 million (+61.7% YoY), management citing an edge-AI product push across multiple end markets.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Application processor SoCs for tablets, set-top boxes, and embedded/IoT devices.
